answer: The zenith chain is verified at intake and vertex publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a anchor checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 790 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
